chunks: And they said: 'Are our deities better or he?' They say this only for disputing. Surely they are a contentious people.

key_terms.آلِهَتُنَا: Our deities (plural of ilah, referring to idols)

ai.seo_question: Why did the polytheists claim their idols were better than Allah?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the rhetorical strategy of the Quraysh, who used 'jadal' (disputation) to mask their spiritual blindness and stubbornness in rejecting the Prophet's message. It underscores the transition from polite debate to inherent conflict, illustrating how polytheists prioritize maintaining their status quo over accepting divine truth. This characterization serves as a critique of those who argue not to find truth, but to win.
